description: This file defines the EmployeeTerminationAPI class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin API, providing RESTful endpoints for managing employee termination records including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion. It includes validation rules, Swagger/OpenAPI annotations, and uses traits and external services for business logic.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationAPI
classes.description: REST API class for handling employee termination records in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, offering endpoints to retrieve, create, update, and delete termination records with validation and Swagger annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific employee termination record by ID and employee number.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new employee termination record for a specified employee.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing employee termination record by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove an employee's termination record.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee number and termination record ID from the request URL.

methods.name: setEmployeeTerminationRecord
methods.description: Populates an EmployeeTerminationRecord object with data from the request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a specific termination record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Not implemented - would return validation rules for listing termination records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a termination record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a termination record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting a termination record.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules common to create and update operations.
